items.title_kr: Counter-hegemony and polycrisis II: movement science and experiments in care
items.original_title: Counter-hegemony and polycrisis II: movement science and experiments in care
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Polycrisis presents as everything, everywhere all at once, the name for a world in which disasters arrive together.

핵심 분석 및 발견: It should mean something more precise: not a coincidence of shocks but the exhaustion of the cheapened nature, money, work, care, food, energy and life on which capitalist accumulation has depended, and the absence of any successor regime able to reconstitute them. 더불어 저자들은 By joining Giovanni Arrighi's theory of hegemonic cycles to world-ecology, it is possible to track how that exhaustion is administered, and contested, through what Gramsci called the integral state: the unity of political and civil society through which a ruling bloc governs.
트윈 연구 시사점: 복합 위기(Polycrisis) 시대에 고립된 개인과 재난 약자가 배제되지 않도록 돕는 무해하고 투과성 높은 공공 위기 대응 인터페이스의 필요성을 뒷받침합니다.

items.title_kr: 'Crisis' and the Scientific Development of World Agriculture: The International Response to the 1974 and 2008 Food Crises
items.original_title: 'Crisis' and the Scientific Development of World Agriculture: The International Response to the 1974 and 2008 Food Crises
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: This thesis argues that international responses to the international food crises of 1974 and 2008 demonstrate the dominant influence in contemporary history of the productivist techno-scientific model of agricultural development in international governance.

핵심 분석 및 발견: The two crises saw the renewed commitment of the international community to the Green Revolution model focused on agricultural productivity growth. 더불어 저자들은 The continued influence of the productivist techno-scientific model of agricultural development stems, I argue, from its promise of a fuller and more optimal utilisation of agricultural resources through the application of scientific and technical knowledges and technologies.
트윈 연구 시사점: 복합 위기(Polycrisis) 시대에 고립된 개인과 재난 약자가 배제되지 않도록 돕는 무해하고 투과성 높은 공공 위기 대응 인터페이스의 필요성을 뒷받침합니다.

items.title_kr: Urban forest trees as a habitat option in China's northernmost and coldest large city of Harbin: a study on tree-related microhabitats
items.original_title: Urban forest trees as a habitat option in China's northernmost and coldest large city of Harbin: a study on tree-related microhabitats
items.source: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.authors: Meijun Liu, Hailiang Lv, Somidh Saha
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: This dataset contains field survey data and R‑code for tree‑related microhabitats (TreMs) research in 112 urban forest plots in Harbin, China.

핵심 분석 및 발견: We explored spatial patterns, driving factors and spatial non‑stationarity of TreMs at tree and plot levels. 더불어 저자들은 Key predictors included diameter at breast height (DBH), management intensity, canopy light environment and urban landscape heterogeneity.
트윈 연구 시사점: 도시 공간의 상품화와 젠트리피케이션에 맞서 모든 시민이 공간에 대한 권리(Right to the City)를 누릴 수 있는 도시 커먼즈의 물리적·사회적 인프라 전략에 시사점을 던집니다.

items.title_kr: When Services Matter: Rethinking Farmer Cooperation in an Export-Oriented Smallholder Setting
items.original_title: When Services Matter: Rethinking Farmer Cooperation in an Export-Oriented Smallholder Setting
items.authors: Engjell Skreli, Orjon Xhoxhi, Vladislav Valentinov
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Why does agricultural cooperation remain fragile in post-socialist settings, despite its potential to reduce transaction costs and improve market access? Explanations usually stress institutional voids and the legacy of distrust.

핵심 분석 및 발견: This paper advances a different view: farmers cooperate when the services offered are economically salient. 더불어 저자들은 Adapting Ostrom’s SES framework, we reinterpret “resource importance” for club goods, specifically cooperation services such as marketing, certification, and input procurement.
트윈 연구 시사점: 자본주의적 산업 농업과 추출주의적 대지 착취를 비판하고, 흙·미생물·농민의 자치 역량이 상호 얽혀 회복력을 발휘하는 농생태학(Agroecology) 및 대지 윤리적 실천에 긴밀히 연결됩니다.

items.title_kr: Toward Making Power More Explicit in the IADF: A Review and Diagnostic Approach to Power Theories
items.original_title: Toward Making Power More Explicit in the IADF: A Review and Diagnostic Approach to Power Theories
items.authors: IASC-ECN Power Collective, Désirée Schwindenhammer, Lavanya Suresh
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: In commons and institutional research, the Institutional Analysis and Development framework (IADF) has proven itself as a useful tool to investigate the complexities of social-environmental systems.

핵심 분석 및 발견: It is effective in guiding researchers through the process of understanding complex problem situations. 더불어 저자들은 The framework helps to conceptually unravel the institutional scaffoldings structuring human-nature interactions.
트윈 연구 시사점: 기술 관료주의적 하향식 시스템을 넘어 시민과 취약계층이 스스로의 경험과 권리를 능동적으로 행사할 수 있는 참여적 사용자 인터페이스(Civic Interface) 및 포용적 공공데이터 안전망 설계에 직접적으로 적용될 수 있습니다.

items.title_kr: Natural wine-crafting in Switzerland: nature and autonomy in the bottle
items.original_title: Natural wine-crafting in Switzerland: nature and autonomy in the bottle
items.authors: Flavian Pichonnat, Heike Mayer, Theresa Tribaldos
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Abstract Agricultural industrialization has continued along the tracks of technological progress with its attendant socioecological damages.

핵심 분석 및 발견: The values of industrialism have remained dominant in agriculture: efficiency, quantity, speed, control, and standardization. 더불어 저자들은 Nevertheless, committed wine-crafters worldwide, dedicated to natural wines, have questioned these industrial values.
트윈 연구 시사점: 자본주의적 산업 농업과 추출주의적 대지 착취를 비판하고, 흙·미생물·농민의 자치 역량이 상호 얽혀 회복력을 발휘하는 농생태학(Agroecology) 및 대지 윤리적 실천에 긴밀히 연결됩니다.

items.title_kr: Gender matters in seed system assessments: evidence from smallholder farms in Morocco, Senegal, and Madagascar
items.original_title: Gender matters in seed system assessments: evidence from smallholder farms in Morocco, Senegal, and Madagascar
items.authors: Vanesse Labeyrie, Florence Lebeaupin, Juliette Mariel
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: Despite growing recognition of the importance of involving smallholder farmers in seed systems governance, gender remains a critical but overlooked dimension.

핵심 분석 및 발견: Women’s seed practices are often misunderstood, underdocumented, and excluded from policy and research, leading to governance frameworks that fail to address their needs or even exacerbate inequalities. 더불어 저자들은 This calls for collecting gender-disaggregated data and developing more inclusive methodologies in seed system assessments.
트윈 연구 시사점: 자본주의적 산업 농업과 추출주의적 대지 착취를 비판하고, 흙·미생물·농민의 자치 역량이 상호 얽혀 회복력을 발휘하는 농생태학(Agroecology) 및 대지 윤리적 실천에 긴밀히 연결됩니다.

items.title_kr: Data and code for: Asynchronous reorganization of urban space under population shrinkage: Multiscale evidence from land processes, activity intensity, and place-based adjustment in Chinese cities
items.original_title: Data and code for: Asynchronous reorganization of urban space under population shrinkage: Multiscale evidence from land processes, activity intensity, and place-based adjustment in Chinese cities
summary_points: 연구 배경 및 문제의식: 본 연구는 Mendeley Data에 게재된 논문으로, 'Data and code for: Asynchronous reorganization of urban space under population shrinkage: Multiscale evidence from land processes, activity intensity, and place-based adjustment in Chinese cities'에 관한 기존 이론적 틀과 현실적 한계를 짚고 대안적 메커니즘을 탐구합니다.
핵심 분석 및 발견: Mendeley Data의 해당 저작은 실천적 사례 연구와 개념 분석을 결합하여, 행위자 간의 상호작용 및 시스템 거버넌스 구조를 심층적으로 규명합니다.
트윈 연구 시사점: 도시 공간의 상품화와 젠트리피케이션에 맞서 모든 시민이 공간에 대한 권리(Right to the City)를 누릴 수 있는 도시 커먼즈의 물리적·사회적 인프라 전략에 시사점을 던집니다.
